description: Source code for jQuery UI's draggable widget, version 1.14.1, enabling drag-and-drop interactions for web elements.

classes.name: ui.draggable
classes.description: Main class implementing draggable behavior, including event handling, containment, snapping, and interaction with droppables and sortables.

methods.name: _create
methods.description: Initializes the draggable widget, sets position, handle classes, and binds mouse events.

methods.name: _setOption
methods.description: Updates widget options dynamically, handling handle changes.

methods.name: _destroy
methods.description: Cleans up the widget, removing classes and unbinding events.

methods.name: _mouseCapture
methods.description: Determines if a mousedown event should initiate dragging, checking handle and disabled state.

methods.name: _blockFrames
methods.description: Prevents iframe interactions during drag by overlaying transparent divs.

methods.name: _unblockFrames
methods.description: Removes iframe overlays after drag.

methods.name: _blurActiveElement
methods.description: Blurs the currently focused element to prevent conflicts during drag.

methods.name: _mouseStart
methods.description: Begins dragging, creating helper, setting offsets, and triggering start events.

methods.name: _refreshOffsets
methods.description: Calculates current offsets for accurate positioning during drag.

methods.name: _mouseDrag
methods.description: Handles the dragging movement, updating helper position and triggering drag events.

methods.name: _mouseStop
methods.description: Ends dragging, handles revert logic, and triggers stop events.

methods.name: _mouseUp
methods.description: Handles mouse release, finalizes drag, and cleans up.

methods.name: cancel
methods.description: Cancels the current drag operation.

methods.name: _getHandle
methods.description: Determines if the event target is a valid handle for dragging.

methods.name: _setHandleClassName
methods.description: Adds handle class to the handle element.

methods.name: _removeHandleClassName
methods.description: Removes handle class from the handle element.

methods.name: _createHelper
methods.description: Creates the helper element used during dragging.

methods.name: _setPositionRelative
methods.description: Sets the element's position to relative if not already positioned.

methods.name: _adjustOffsetFromHelper
methods.description: Adjusts mouse offset based on cursorAt option.

methods.name: _isRootNode
methods.description: Checks if an element is html or body.

methods.name: _getParentOffset
methods.description: Calculates the offset of the parent element.

methods.name: _getRelativeOffset
methods.description: Calculates relative offset if position is relative.

methods.name: _cacheMargins
methods.description: Caches element margins.

methods.name: _cacheHelperProportions
methods.description: Caches helper element dimensions.

methods.name: _setContainment
methods.description: Sets containment boundaries for dragging.

methods.name: _convertPositionTo
methods.description: Converts position to absolute or relative coordinates.

methods.name: _generatePosition
methods.description: Calculates the new position during dragging, considering containment, grid, and axis constraints.

methods.name: _clear
methods.description: Clears helper and resets state after drag.

methods.name: _trigger
methods.description: Triggers widget events and calls plugins.

methods.name: _uiHash
methods.description: Returns a hash of UI data for event callbacks.
